text: Vitaldin is a brand of Boston Nutraceutical Science, which forms part of Mercadalia, a Spanish industrial group; Vitaldin is a registered trademark of Boston Nutraceutical Science S.L. (BNS).
short: Vitaldin is a brand of Boston Nutraceutical Science, part of the Spanish group Mercadalia.
